info.title: NAMA Analyze Demo API
info.description: Labelled illustrative data, not verified market intelligence. Private workspace operations use Django sessions and CSRF.

get.description: Demo-only CSV, with explicit USD/provenance columns; maximum 1000 records.

post.description: Fetch /auth/csrf/ first and send X-CSRFToken. Django rotates the session/CSRF token on login.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Use csrfToken from /auth/csrf/ with its cookie; login rotates it and returns the next token.
